Definition: Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jarmuth = "heights"; 1) a Canaanitish city in the lowlands of Judah with a king and located between Hebron and Lachish; 2) a Levitical city of Issachar allocated to the Gershonite Levites
